body.name: schedule-split rare-cell face-switching handle
body.construction: Embed the endpoint LP in support-stratified feasible charts and localize its active primal and dual faces on the \(2\times2\) array \(p_n=r_n=(\kappa_n,1-\kappa_n)\), taking \(n\kappa_n\to\infty\) and \(\Delta_n\in\{0,\lambda(n\kappa_n)^{-1/2}\}\) for fixed \(\lambda\). For sufficiency, combine row-feasible perturbation bounds with Gaussian anti-concentration under \(n\kappa_n^3\to\infty\), \((n\kappa_n)^{-1/2}=o(t_n)\), and \(t_n=o(\kappa_n)\). For procedural sharpness, fix the schedule first. If \(t_n/\kappa_n\not\to0\), pass to a subsequence and choose a boundary array on which the feasibility correction is active with nonvanishing probability, then calculate its effect on the paired critical value. If \(t_n/\kappa_n\to0\) while \(\limsup_n n\kappa_n^3<\infty\), use the zero or local contrast to test whether rare-cell noise prevents optimal-face localization. In either branch, establish an actual limiting critical-value or coverage distortion rather than only failure of a proof condition.
